description: Run the final QKV plateau check after one empty band
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,597 parameters at 99.000000%, exactly threshold. There have been 62 prior macro-attempts and 538 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0163/micro-0002 at 1,597/99.00%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0164/micro-0001, where pair 661/747 scored 98.99% at 1,596. Thirteen measured sensitive pairs are excluded. Hypothesis: one more skip may expose a qualifying band, as it did after earlier isolated failures; if its first candidate fails, two consecutive no-accept macros establish the predeclared local plateau. The helper adds one ordered eligible union per official micro-trial with runner-only retention/rollback. Stop at first scored discard/error, no pair, 20 trials, or 25 minutes. This is more informative than prematurely abandoning the high-yield QKV family because it applies an explicit replication-based stopping criterion.
summary: The final QKV plateau check evaluated two ordered unions. The first qualified at 1,596 parameters and was retained; the second proposed 1,595, failed qualification, and was rolled back. Outcomes: 1 accept, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors. Compute used two official migrations/verifications over about 2m25s. Stop reason: first scored discard; the proposed two-empty-band plateau was falsified by the first accept.
